graph.notJson: This file is not readable JSON: {reason}
graph.notWorkflow: This file is not a ComfyUI workflow.
graph.canvasFormat: This is a workflow saved from the ComfyUI canvas, which cannot be run over the API. In ComfyUI use Workflow → Export (API) and save that file here instead.
graph.noNodes: Nothing in this file looks like a ComfyUI node. Export it again with Workflow → Export (API).
graph.noSampler: No sampler here: nothing in this workflow takes a positive and a negative conditioning, so there is nowhere to put a prompt.
graph.manySamplers: There are {count} samplers with no link between them ({samplers}). The prompt was bound to {chosen}; the others keep whatever text was saved in them. Repoint it if that is the wrong one.
graph.manyTextNodes: {count} text nodes lead to {slot} ({nodes}). {chosen} was chosen; pick another if that is wrong.
graph.sameNode: Positive and negative both lead to {node}, so the negative is left unbound.
graph.noPrompt: No prompt node is bound, so there is nowhere to put what is asked for. Point "Prompt" at the text node this workflow uses.
graph.noSeed: No seed was found. ComfyUI caches by workflow, so the same prompt will return the same picture every time.
graph.noOutput: No node saves an image, so this workflow would run and produce nothing to keep.
graph.staleBinding: The saved binding for "{slot}" points at node #{node} {field}, which this workflow no longer has.
graph.staleBindingReplaced: The saved binding for "{slot}" points at node #{node} {field}, which this workflow no longer has. Using {detected} {detectedField} instead.

It says what moves and nothing of who she is, since the picture already shows her, so one prompt serves every character. A sex-act drawn pregnant uses the prompt of the sex-act it is built on.
